# Tanvir Ibn Mizan

> Tanvir Ibn Mizan (also known as 7ANV1R) is a software engineer at weDevs who builds cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter. This is his official website: https://tanvir.wiki

## About
- Software engineer focused on cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, mobile UI design, and clean, maintainable code.
- Tools: Flutter, Dart, React, Node.js, Firebase, Supabase, Figma, Rive.

## Experience
- Software Engineer, weDevs (Sep 2024 – Present)
- Mobile Application Developer (Flutter), RetinaSoft (May 2023 – Aug 2024)
- Junior Mobile Application Developer (Flutter), NexusLab (Aug 2021 – Sep 2022)

## Projects
- [Weather Assistant – Flutter MCP](https://github.com/7ANV1R/flutter-mcp-chatbot): conversational weather chatbot (Flutter, mcp_dart, OpenAI, OpenWeather API)
- [Tyke – Shoe App](https://github.com/7ANV1R/shoe_app): Flutter carousel animation UI demo
